6756789866.name: Escalator Field Command
6756789866.description:
Built for Escalator Mechanics. Everything You Need in the Field.

Escalator Field Command is the professional-grade tool for escalator mechanics who want to work faster, stay organized, and ensure compliance with 100% on-device data and no sign-up required.

THE FIELD GUIDE: THE CODE, ANSWERED IN PLAIN ENGLISH.
Your subscriber Field Guide puts escalator and moving walk requirements, drawn from ASME A17.1/CSA B44 and MCP, right in your pocket. Ask a question the way you’d ask a senior mechanic, typed or spoken, and get a clear, sourced answer in seconds. Jump straight to any section by its code number, bookmark and highlight the rules you lean on most, and open linked references without ever leaving the app. The code, finally searchable.

YOUR ROUTE. YOUR RECORDS. YOUR WAY.
Add every escalator on your maintenance route with detailed unit information, service history, and key notes. Instantly accessible, always offline. No more flipping through notes or searching multiple systems.

CAT1 TESTING, SIMPLIFIED.
Category 1 testing is broken into four colour-coded sections for at-a-glance progress tracking. Always know what’s complete and what’s outstanding. Put a unit on hold when it’s out for the year, and share a completion report showing every unit’s pass or fail.

ALL YOUR DOCUMENTS, ALWAYS OFFLINE.
Upload manuals, test reports, photos, and any supporting documents so everything related to the job lives in one place, organized and available without an internet connection. Search inside a PDF for a word or a part number and jump straight to the page it is on.

LOG HOURS & TRACK TIME.
Log time tickets for maintenance, repairs, travel, and training. Weekly timesheets auto-fill from your records. Copy a whole day as one block of text to paste into your company’s system, or send it as a PDF with your parking and expenses and a photo of each receipt. A morning notice tells you what is due before you set off.

PLAN AHEAD. REPORT WITH CONFIDENCE.
See your upcoming service jobs right on the dashboard so bigger work never sneaks up on you, and check them off once they're done. Then generate polished PDF reports, including the State of the Union, a route-wide snapshot of where every unit stands. Need something else? Write your own report for a building, pick the units, attach photos, and share it in seconds.

Set up the things that come round again, a safety meeting, a monthly report, an annual recertification, and whatever falls on today is waiting across the top of your dashboard when you open the app. Units already on a maintenance schedule are added for you.

In British Columbia, fill in the Technical Safety BC Escalator Data Sheet Checklist on site and send it as a PDF instead of carrying paper.

FLAG ISSUES BEFORE THEY ESCALATE.
Rate each unit’s priority and tick off its open items one at a time. Never lose a follow-up.

ONBOARD NEW MECHANICS INSTANTLY.
Incoming mechanics gain immediate access to historical test data and unit notes. Institutional knowledge is preserved. Transition time is minimized.

PRIVACY FIRST. ALWAYS.
All data lives on your device. No cloud account. No internet required. No sign-up. Daily backups, and one export file carries records, photos and manuals to a new phone or a coworker. Want a copy off the phone? Optional iCloud Backup saves one a day to your own iCloud Drive. It stays off unless you turn it on. iPhone and iPad.

PRO SUBSCRIPTION
The app is free to download, and the free version keeps up to three of your own escalators. A Pro subscription unlocks unlimited escalators and all features, and new subscribers get the first month free.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

HealthTrail Medical: 
The future of patient-centric medical management

Have you ever sat in a doctor’s office and blanked on the date of your last tetanus shot? Or struggled to remember the exact name of the medication your aging parent was prescribed last year?

HealthTrail is the digital "medical memory" for your entire family. It eliminates the guesswork from healthcare by providing an instant, visual timeline of every medical event, medication, and milestone. Whether you are managing your own health, keeping track of your children's development, or acting as a caregiver for elderly parents, HealthTrail ensures that the right information is always in your pocket.

Why Use HealthTrail?
Medical history is often scattered across different clinics, portals, and paper files. HealthTrail centralizes it all so you can:

* Be Prepared for Appointments: Instantly answer questions like "When was your last colonoscopy?" or "What was the result of that blood test?"
* Coordinate Care: Manage multiple family members’ profiles in one place.
* Keep Perfect Records: Attach photos of lab results, pill bottles, or discharge papers directly to specific events.

CORE FEATURES

Visual Health Timeline
* A beautiful, chronological view of your complete medical history.
* Track doctor visits, specialist appointments, surgeries, and screenings (like Pap smears or colonoscopies).
* Vaccines you record show up on your Timeline too. 

Smart Medication Management
* AI Scan: Snap a photo of a pill bottle, and the AI automatically extracts the details.
* History: Keep a record of both active and past prescriptions, including dosages and refill dates.

Comprehensive Vaccine Tracking
Never lose track of your immunization records again.
* Complete History: Log every vaccination from childhood boosters to annual flu shots and travel vaccines.
* Instant Access: When schools, workplaces, or travel authorities ask for proof of vaccination, you have the dates and photos of your records ready to go.

Lab Results & Health Metrics
* Track cholesterol, blood sugar, kidney and liver results, blood pressure and more, with a trend chart for each.
* AI Scan: Photograph a lab report and the values are filled in for you, including reports in Portuguese.
* Normal ranges from Canadian and Brazilian medical guidelines, in the units your lab uses (Brazil shows mg/dL, g/dL and ng/mL).
* Your own range: enter the range from your lab report or a goal from your doctor. Personal ranges are clearly marked as yours.
* My Tests: add any test the app doesn't list, like vitamin D or thyroid (TSH), with its own unit.

Family Profiles
* Create separate profiles for children, spouses, or elderly parents.
* Switch between profiles with a single tap. Perfect for caregivers. 

Insurance & Documentation
* Insurance Cards: Upload a photo for automatic data extraction. Never fumble at the pharmacy again.
* Work-Related Tracking: Flag injuries or appointments for insurance claims and workplace documentation.
Private by design
* Your records are stored on your device, not in a cloud account we control, and never sold or shared for advertising.
* Optional AI scanning: when you choose to scan a photo of a document, card, or label, that image is sent to our AI provider to read it and is not stored by them for training. Everything else stays on your device.
* You control your own backups and exports.

6766699306.description:
RidgePacker: Gear Organizer & Packing List

Stop showing up to the trailhead with the wrong gear, or worse, forgetting it entirely. RidgePacker is the gear management app built for hikers, backpackers, and everyday carry enthusiasts who care about what they bring and how much it weighs.

YOUR GEAR CATALOG
Build a permanent catalog of everything you own. Add photos, weights, brand details, category tags, and product links. The AI scanner identifies your gear from a photo and fills in the specs automatically. Search your whole catalog straight from your iPhone's Home Screen, even with the app closed.

TRIP PLANNING
Create a trip, pull gear from your catalog, and pack against your list. Set a target weight for any pack or sublist and see how far under or over you are as you add gear. Need more than one of something? Set a quantity and your totals add it up. Prefer it simple? Turn off the check-off circles in Settings and let the list itself be your pack.

BASE WEIGHT & CONSUMABLES
Flag food, water, and fuel as consumables and RidgePacker splits your load into base weight, consumables, and worn weight. See your true base weight: the carried, non-consumed number that matters most when you're trying to pack lighter.

NOTES
Tap the note row at the top of any pack or sublist to jot reminders: campsite details, gear swaps, anything you don't want to forget.

SUBLISTS & MODULAR POUCHES
Organize a big trip the way you actually pack it. Break any pack into sublists (a day pack, what's left behind, what the porters carry), then group gear inside them into modular pouches like a first-aid kit or a cook set, up to three levels deep. Move a pouch into another sublist, to your pack's top level, or onto your body, and it stays a pouch wherever it lands. Each pack, sublist, and pouch tracks its own weight, rolls up automatically, and can carry its own weight goal.

JUST FOR THIS TRIP
Add one-off items (extra socks, snacks, toiletries) that belong to this trip only. Full photo and weight tracking, without cluttering your permanent gear catalog.

ON YOUR BODY
Separate your worn gear from your packed gear. Mark hiking boots, a trail hat, or a buff as "On Your Body." Body weight is tracked independently and you choose whether it counts toward your pack weight. On a multi-pack trip, set which pack you're carrying (the whole trip or one sublist) and pack weight reflects exactly what's on your back.

EVERYDAY CARRY
Maintain a separate gear list for what you carry every day. Independent from your trip lists, always one tap away.

IMPORT YOUR GEAR
Already track your kit in LighterPack or a spreadsheet? Import your gear list from a CSV file and bring everything into RidgePacker in a single step, with units, categories, and consumables included.

SHARE & EXPORT
Turn any trip into a beautifully formatted PDF packing list with photos, weights, category charts, and every sublist and modular pouch. Choose exactly what to include, then print it or share it with a hiking partner.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account required. No ads. No cross-app tracking. Your gear catalog and packing lists are stored on your iPhone, not in the cloud. Back them up yourself, whenever you want.

TRY IT FREE
Start with 14 days of full access, completely free: every feature, no account, no commitment. After that, your gear and lists are always there to browse and pack against; a RidgePacker Pro subscription keeps you adding, editing, AI-scanning, and organizing without limits.

6813696329.name: Family Lists
6813696329.description:
A grocery list your household shares. Gift lists where nobody spoils the surprise. And now, a planner for the big family dinner.

GROCERY
Everyone in your household adds to the same list and ticks things off as they go. Add milk on the couch and it shows up on the phone of whoever's at the store a second later. Items you buy often turn into one-tap quick picks, so a weekly shop takes seconds to write. Add something you've bought before and it comes back with its quantity, store, note and photo already filled in.

Give items a category or a store and sort the list either way, or by who added it. Your household keeps its own list of stores. The app learns where you usually buy each thing and fills the store in. Filter down to one store when you're standing in it. No signal in the store? The list still works, and ticks save once you're back online. A history keeps track of what got bought, and by whom. On iPhone, put the list on your home screen with a widget in teal, cream or light teal.

Your household is its own group, separate from the wider family below. Usually that's the people at home, useful when grandparents are family for gifts but buy their own groceries.

GIFTS
Each person keeps a wish list the rest of the family can see. When Mom buys something off Jim's list, she marks it bought. Dad and Sally see that it's taken so nobody doubles up. Jim never does. What has or hasn't been bought from your own list stays hidden from you, always.

Marking a gift bought is press and hold, so a stray tap in front of the wrong person gives nothing away. Want more than one of something? Ask for 5 packs of Pokémon cards and each person picks how many they're getting.

Bought something? Leave yourself a private note on it, like where it's hidden, and a tag like Christmas. Share notes with your spouse one gift at a time, or a whole list at once. The person it's for never sees them. Gift History keeps a record of everything you've bought, and you can hide any gift you don't need to see.

You can also keep private gift ideas for someone, notes only you can see. Or make a private list only one person sees, like stocking stuffers for your partner. You pick who in the family sees your wish list at all. Keep one running wish list, or separate lists for Christmas and birthdays. Tag gifts and sort any list by tag, name or date.

If a family member can't keep a secret, turn on Blabbermouth Mode for them and pick whose lists they can't see purchases on. They can still add and buy gifts; they just can't spoil those surprises. You can even keep it secret from them.

HOSTING
Hosting Christmas dinner for 22? Switch on Hosting in Settings and you get a third tab for big family meals.

Keep one guest list for the whole extended family, grouped into parties, with children and high chairs counted separately. Tag each guest with a clan (your side, your spouse's side) and filter the list down. Tick people in as they say yes. Set up tables with a number of seats and pick who sits where; a table goes red when it's over.

Plan the menu by course and hand dishes out, so you know who's bringing the potatoes and which dish is still nobody's job. The app adds up the plates, forks, chairs and wine glasses you'll need against what you own and where you keep the spares.

A household admin picks who can make changes; everyone else can look without editing anything.

Next year, start from last year's dinner. The guest list, tables and menu come with it, along with the note you left yourself about running out of gravy.

HOW IT WORKS
Sign in with Apple or a secure emailed code, no password to remember. Start a family, then send people an invite link or let them scan a QR code with their phone's camera, app or no app. One link can bring them into your grocery list too. Belong to several families and switch in Settings. Lock the app with Face ID if you like, and choose day or night.

Free, with no ads.

6826464717.name: Junkyard Titans
6826464717.description:
Junkyard Titans is a block puzzle where every line you crush pays out in robot parts, and the robots you build fight.

Drag chunks of scrap onto an 8 by 8 grid. Fill a row or a column and the crusher flattens it. Crush a line with piece after piece and the streak bonus climbs. Watch out for rusted blocks later in a run. They take two hits.

Every 10 lines fills a crate. Crack it open and three parts fall out: heads, arms, legs, bodies and power cores. Most are Scrap. Salvage and Chrome turn up less often, and Polished Titanium is rare. Once in a long while a crate holds a Prototype, a bright yellow part with its own ability or a machine for your warehouse.

Fill all six slots on a robot's blueprint page and it boots up. There are nine to build in the first junkyard, from Scrapjaw (half of a 1987 pickup truck) to HankBot, a golden retriever who fetches bolts. Melt spares into bolts, upgrade the parts you love, or combine three into a rarer one.

Then take your ScrapBot into the Arena and climb 20 rungs of Preston Shine's crew. He's the rich kid on the hill who dumps last week's bot in your junkyard, and he has opinions about yours. Every round you pick ATTACK, GUARD or a special move.

Boot all nine and they combine into a Junkyard Titan. Beat Preston's solid gold GOLDEN BOY and the next junkyard opens: neon robots, then a frozen war camp where every robot swings a weapon, then a dead appliance showroom where the fridges fight back.

Every part, shirt, crate and supply is a trading card, and the Binder tab keeps your whole collection in one place, with doubles stacked and a search box to find any card. Add friends with a code and trade almost anything: spare parts, clothes, banners, decorations, resources, crates, even bolts to even out a deal. Post a wish list, send a gift, or fight a friend live. Player names are made by the game, and there's no chat.

Send your robots out scavenging and they come back hours later with scrap steel, springs, glass, rare circuit boards and more. Some Shop items need them. Sell spares on the SCRAP 500, a junkyard market where prices move every day, so it pays to sell when they're up. Every yard is rich in two resources and short of two others, which is what friends are for.

Not in the mood to fight? Nut Sort and Tow Out are puzzles with no daily limit. The Daily Puzzle hands you one board and a fixed set of pieces, the Scrap Claw gives you five free drops a day and shows the odds, and three Daily Jobs pay a crate each. Every day a broken robot gets dumped at the gate for you to rewire. There are 28 achievements to chase.

Buy a warehouse behind the Garage and fill it with furniture: a jukebox, a pinball machine, a car lift, display dummies for your best outfits, and an arcade machine with its own shooter. Every piece on display gives a small perk. Somewhere in the third junkyard you'll win a mechanical egg that knocks back when you tap it. In the fourth it hatches into a robot pet you name, feed, clean and play with. It grows up, helps in fights with its own move and naps in a pet bed you pick.

Dress your ScrapBot in shirts, boots, masks and 28 hats. Holidays bring their own clothes and garage lights, out for a few weeks each year. Most of it is earned by playing or bought with bolts. Optional purchases: Battle Banners, some masks, some shirts, junkyard photo walls, meme floors and signs, Slay Queens signs (these only change how things look), the Overclock Chip, one a day, which adds 3 levels to a part, and Polished Titanium filament for the 3-D Printer, which also costs bolts. Crates, bolts and claw drops can't be bought with real money.

No ads.
